verdict.rationale: All options can plausibly satisfy the before-5-p.m. lodge-arrival constraint, but none clearly dominates on the stated facts. B has the lowest quoted airfare/points cost and avoids flight connections, but its total cost and final arrival time depend on rental-car pickup and driving. C has the simplest JAC itinerary and an early arrival, but is the most expensive. D is earlier and cheaper than C but adds a second connection. A meets the shuttle cutoff but trades a very long layover against fewer connections than D. Choosing among these tradeoffs requires unstated preferences about price, points value, driving, layovers, and connection risk.
